Job Description: The Enterprise Data Solutions & Operations (EDSO) team within the Digital & Technology (D-T) function is looking to staff a Head of Data Solutions (the ‘Role’) for our FPRS/CSWM line of business. This role will work closely with core FPRS/CSWM business value streams (e.g., distribution mgmt., shop, purchasing, service, claims, etc.) to define, shape, prioritize and lead the delivery and evolution of key data and information product (‘Products’) solutions supporting business objectives. More specifically, this role will drive the capture and planning for new demand of features and/or enhancements to Guardian’s data Products as articulated by key business leaders from one or more key value stream and/or the respective FPRS/CSWM FP&A functional BI leader. These data Products include everything from consumer-facing analytics (reports/dashboards), to inter/intra-application data services (APIs/extracts/shares), to data services supporting AI/GenAI automation, to the underlying data definitions and reference data that define the FPRS/CSWM businesses. In addition, this role will have accountability for planning and delivering strategic data initiatives within one or more FPRS/CSWM value stream, collaborating with the value stream Digital & Tech (D&T) Leader, the value stream Business Leader, the value stream Product Delivery Managers (PDMs), and the value stream Product Owners(POs)) to identify/scope/size and execute key data needs, and to identify and raise new opportunities for data activation/adoption. A key aspect of the role will be to balance the needs across value stream demands, soliciting/recommending priorities, and in turn, incorporating and aligning these priorities into a roadmap and plan for delivery, including resource planning (business SMEs, UAT participants, etc.), training, and activation in support of full value realization. Finally, the FPRS/CSWM Data Solution Head will direct the data steward(s) in their charter to continuously capture metadata related to all data elements (e.g., definition, quality standards, calculation logic, SLA requirements, etc.), and to report/coordinate any data quality issues/SLA breaches/definitional changes to the same. From a strategic management perspective, the role will bring a keen understanding of value stream processes, supporting applications and key data elements. Moreover, the role will establish and nurture relationships with both value stream executive leadership, as well as functional and analytic SMEs in the value stream teams to keep a pulse on the latent needs and direction of the business. Using these relationships, the role will anticipate future data needs, constantly updating and communicating the backlog of features to be addressed in the data/info product roadmap - all in close coordination with business partners in the FPRS/CSWM FP&A analytics team(s). From an org management perspective, the Role will directly manage and grow a team of data product owners (DPOs).  These DPOs will be aligned with FPRS/CSWM value stream data products and will drive the execution of new build features/enhancements to their respective data products. In addition, the Role will manage both direct (EDSO FPRS/CSWM Solution Engineering team members, EDSO FPRS/CSWM Data Product Owners) and indirect (D&T Solution & Data Architecture resources, and D&T Data Governance resources), in order to drive the successful delivery of data products, as well as to help foster the development of the next generation of D&T data leaders, You are: You are a highly independent senior manager with the ability to (or rapidly become) conversant in life insurance and wealth management products and their respective business processes. You have an aptitude for using and shaping data solutions in support of business objectives and are able to clearly articulate the value that can be attributable to data/info products. You are highly organized, staying abreast of multiple stakeholders’ priorities, the status of multiple parallel initiatives/projects/data products, and the state of value realization and adoption for production data assets. You communicate fluidly and extemporaneously, able to articulate how data solution functionality will meet business needs in a brief, non-technical manner. While you may not be a recent ‘hands on keyboards’ technologist (you may even have come from a business or analytical background), you have a deep understanding of data and analytic technologies, architectural principles, and you aren’t afraid to dig into data models and pipeline logic. Finally, you are reliable in terms of your commitments, honest and brave with issues/escalations, and have a client service mentality. You have: 15+ years of experience with an escalating competency in data and analytic solutions BS or BA required; MS or MBA preferred 3+ years working in an agile environment 3+ years of experience managing staff/teams, potentially (preferably) with geographically diverse teams, often organized on a product delivery basis (highly matrixed) 5+ years of experience with standard program management tools (such as JIRA, AgileCraft, ATIIM, etc.), as well as desktop collaboration/ideation tools (Sharepoint, MSOffice, OneDrive, Lucid, Draw.io, etc.) Experience in life insurance and wealth management products and industry preferred (e.g., whole/term/universal/supplemental/etc., as well as , FIA, portfolio/client management tools for FAs/Brokers, etc.) Experience with enterprise data management principles such as data ownership/stewardship (experience as a data domain steward or data product owner would be a plus) Ability to document and capture business requirements in detail, including to changing business needs/priorities Natural ‘teacher’, able to coach business partners on optimal use of data assets to meet stated/latent business needs Comfort with/knowledge of analytic tools such as Tableau, PowerBI, Databricks, SQL, etc. Deep knowledge/experience with data lakehouse principles and data management tooling (e.g., Databricks, Fivetran, Collibra, SQL/SparkSQL/Python, etc.) Able to see the “big picture” and influence/engage others to meet common goals You Will: Engage in business value stream Counseling: Develop deep and trust-based relationships with value stream value stream leads to the application PDMs) Demonstrate expertise in processes and their supporting data assets by educating business partners (directly 1:1, in formal training sessions, and informally), and by providing direct feedback to value stream owners on usage characteristics of value stream data solutions Product Management: Serve as the primary owner of FPRS/CSWM value stream Job Description: Is the opportunity to join a culture where “We Do the Right Thing,” and “We Courageously Shape Our Future Together” important to you? If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as a Finance Transformation Lead. This role is responsible for driving strategic transformation initiatives across the Finance organization to improve performance, optimize processes, advance AI-enabled capabilities, and strengthen data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Finance & Risk Transformation, Strategy and Operations, s/he will partner closely with Finance, Technology, Risk, Operations, Data, and business leaders to design and implement future-state operating models, modernize planning and reporting processes, and deliver sustainable business value. AI enablement is a core accountability This leader will advance the organization's AI-enabled Finance strategy by embedding Generative AI, intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and agentic AI capabilities into Finance processes, operating models, and ways of working, while ensuring responsible adoption, governance, risk management, and measurable value realization. You will Key Responsibilities Transformation Strategy & Execution Develop and execute Finance transformation strategies aligned with business and enterprise objectives. Lead large-scale transformation initiatives spanning Finance processes, operating models, systems, data, controls, and organizational capabilities. Manage transformation roadmaps, implementation plans, milestones, dependencies, and value realization objectives. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness, decision support, governance, and stakeholder experience. Drive continuous improvement and innovation across Finance functions. AI Enablement & Digital Innovation Lead the Finance AI strategy and roadmap, identifying opportunities to leverage Generative AI, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and agentic AI solutions to improve productivity, decision-making, and business outcomes. Partner with Finance leaders to identify, prioritize, and scale high-value AI use cases across FP&A, forecasting, management reporting, expense management, financial close, workforce planning, and decision support. Drive adoption of enterprise AI capabilities, including Microsoft Copilot, Claude, AI agents, and emerging technologies, ensuring alignment with business priorities and governance expectations. Establish frameworks for AI use case intake, evaluation, prioritization, value realization, adoption measurement, and ongoing performance monitoring. Collaborate with Technology, Data, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Information Security teams to ensure responsible AI adoption and adherence to enterprise governance standards. Lead AI-related change management efforts, including communications, training, stakeholder engagement, and capability-building programs to increase AI literacy across Finance. Measure and track AI adoption, productivity gains, capacity creation, cost savings, decision quality improvements, and other business outcomes. Monitor emerging AI trends, technologies, and industry best practices, translating innovation into actionable opportunities for Finance. Operating Model & Process Transformation Design and implement future-state Finance operating models, governance structures, and service delivery frameworks. Lead process optimization across FP&A, forecasting and budgeting, management reporting, financial close and consolidation, business performance management, expense management, and capital planning. Promote standardization, automation, simplification, and scalable ways of working across Finance processes. Assess organizational readiness, capability gaps, role impacts, and process changes required to sustain transformation outcomes. Technology, Data & Analytics Enablement Partner with Technology and Data teams to lead implementation of Finance platforms, reporting solutions, analytics capabilities, and digital tools. Support transformation initiatives involving ERP modernization, Oracle Planning/EPM, enterprise performance management, reporting platforms, AI-enabled workflows, and automation solutions. Translate business requirements into technology-enabled solutions, user stories, process designs, and implementation roadmaps. Strengthen Finance data quality, consistency, transparency, and accessibility to support analytics, forecasting, and AI-enabled insights. Stakeholder Management, Governance & Change Leadership Serve as a trusted advisor to Finance executives, senior stakeholders, and cross-functional partners. Facilitate executive workshops, strategic planning sessions, use case prioritization discussions, and operating model design conversations. Establish governance structures, reporting mechanisms, risk management routines, and escalation channels for transformation initiatives. Manage vendor, consulting partner, and cross-functional delivery relationships as required. Lead change management, communications, training, and stakeholder engagement activities that support adoption and sustained behavior change. Experience leading AI, Generative AI, automation, digital transformation, or advanced analytics initiatives within Finance or related business functions. Demonstrated ability to identify, prioritize, and implement AI use cases that deliver measurable business value. Strong understanding of Finance operating models, planning, forecasting, reporting, expense management, and performance management processes. Experience developing transformation roadmaps, business cases, benefits realization plans, and executive-level presentations. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders across business, technology, data, risk, and operations. Strong analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, communication, and executive storytelling skills. Preferred Qualifications MBA, CPA, CFA, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, SAFe, or other relevant advanced degree or certification. Experience within Financial Services, Insurance, Banking, Risk Management, or other highly regulated industries. Experience implementing Oracle Planning, Oracle EPM Cloud, Hyperion, SAP, Workday, Anaplan, or similar Finance platforms. Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, agent-based AI solutions, workflow automation, or similar platforms. Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI governance, model risk management, data governance, privacy, information security, and adoption frameworks. Consulting experience with a leading management consulting firm or enterprise transformation practice. Key Competencies Strategic Leadership Enterprise mindset, strategic planning, business acumen, vision-setting, prioritization, and decision-making. Transformation Delivery Program leadership, portfolio management, roadmap execution, risk management, change leadership, and benefits realization. AI & Digital Enablement Generative AI adoption, AI use case identification, intelligent automation, analytics, responsible AI practices, and innovation management. Finance Expertise FP&A, forecasting, reporting, performance management, expense management, operating model design, and process optimization. Relationship Management Executive presence, stakeholder influence, facilitation, cross-functional partnership, and communication. Job Description: The Head of Operational Excellence and Enablement will drive strategic initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, effectiveness, and organizational readiness within the Group Benefits Underwriting organization. This role is accountable for optimizing learning and development, quality assurance programs, underwriting tools, data and operational metrics and capacity while ensuring leaders and teams are fully prepared to adopt new ways of working. This leader will embed best practices, enable accurate and consistent decision-making, and cultivate a culture of continuous improvement while proactively preparing the organization for operational, technological, and capability change. A central responsibility of this role is to ensure underwriting excellence is achieved and sustained through strong execution, readiness, and adoption. You Will Operational Excellence & Enablement Drive innovation and continuous improvement as a core mindset across the underwriting organization. Develop and execute operational excellence strategies aligned to underwriting goals, enterprise priorities, and customer outcomes. Establish performance metrics, benchmarks, and KPIs to measure operational success, decision quality, and underwriting productivity. Utilize data analytics and underwriting tools to generate insights, inform decisions, and proactively optimize execution. Manage quality assurance programs that surface risk, consistency, and training needs—ensuring issues are addressed systematically and sustainably. Partner closely with cross-functional teams to help implement technology solutions and process changes that enhance underwriting workflows and decision-making. Organizational Readiness & Change Leadership Act as a primary owner of organizational readiness for underwriting process, technology, and capability changes. Assess change impact and readiness across underwriting teams, translating operational initiatives into clear people, role, skill, and behavior implications. Lead and embed change enablement practices that ensure smooth adoption of new processes, tools, and operating models. Partner with underwriting leaders to strengthen change leadership capability, ensuring leaders actively sponsor, reinforce, and role-model new ways of working. Identify adoption risks and cultural barriers early, implementing mitigation strategies that support sustained behavioral change. Ensure operational improvements are reinforced through updated operating rhythms, performance expectations, governance, and training—not just documented outcomes. Capability & Culture Building Design and implement best-in-class training programs that elevate underwriting capability, consistency, and decision quality. Provide ongoing support, tools, and resources that enable colleagues to work more efficiently and confidently. Engage stakeholders at all levels to foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and urgent execution. Instill a strong linkage between operational excellence, consumer-centricity, and underwriting excellence. You Are A strategic, outcome oriented thinker with a strong focus on operational excellence and enablement. A people-oriented, change-capable leader who balances execution rigor with adoption and sustainability. Results-driven with a deep sense of accountability and ownership. Adaptable, pragmatic, and effective in evolving and complex environments. You Have Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, or a related field; master’s degree preferred. Minimum of 10 years of experience in underwriting, operations management, or a related field. Proven experience leading operational transformation, large-scale process improvement, and organizational enablement. Strong background in Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement methodologies. Critical Skills People-oriented leader with exceptional ability to inspire teams and build high-performance cultures. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate insight into action. Excellent leadership and stakeholder engagement skills, including influencing at senior levels. Proficiency in data analysis, reporting tools, and operational performance management. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to operate effectively under pressure. The work arrangement for this role will be hybrid (3+ days per week in a Guardian office). Preferred locations include Boston, MA; Bethlehem, PA; and New York, NY.  We will consider remote candidates if experience is aligned . You Are A relationship-driven professional with a passion for building strong partnerships and delivering exceptional customer experiences. A collaborative team player who works effectively across Sales, Client Management, Underwriting, Rating, Onboarding, and external broker partners. A highly organized and detail-oriented individual who can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. A proactive problem solver who balances customer needs with business objectives while maintaining profitability and acceptable risk levels. An effective communicator with strong analytical skills and the ability to influence outcomes through consultative interactions. A trusted resource who leverages technology, business knowledge, and process expertise to support sales growth and operational excellence. You Have BA or BS degree preferred or equivalent work experience. 1-3 years of group insurance experience, preferably processing RFPs. Knowledge of group insurance products and services. Knowledge of underwriting principles and practices. Demonstrated success servicing customers, producers, assistants, and planholders. Experience working with and supporting the needs of a field sales organization in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Proficiency with business applications and systems including Outlook, Salesforce, CPS, Excel, Adobe, SharePoint, Access, and related technologies. Manage duties associated with inventory management, RFP processing, and new business/add issue submissions. Partner closely with Sales Executives, Client Management, Rating, Underwriting, Onboarding, and Producers/Assistants to ensure information required to release competitive quotes and submit new business is received and processed accurately and timely. Review RFP data, identify information received, and determine additional requirements necessary to underwrite and release quotes. Partner with Rating and Quoting teams to ensure proposals remain on track to meet established due dates. Job Description: The Client Manager Associate, Select Market will assume overall responsibility for assisting Sales Representatives in the renewal process as well as recognizing opportunities to add additional lines of coverage to existing business. A successful candidate demonstrates strong customer service acumen, strong consulting/negotiation skills, and a deep product knowledge with a high degree of operational effectiveness. Strong consultative, negotiation, persuasion, and influencing skills with a customer-focused and sales-oriented mindset. Skilled at reviewing, interpreting, and communicating renewal rates, plan options, and coverage recommendations. Knowledgeable in group insurance products, contracts, services, and underwriting principles. Demonstrated success identifying growth opportunities and supporting retention initiatives within an existing book of business. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex information clearly and professionally. Strong analytical and mathematical aptitude with the ability to interpret data and make informed recommendations. Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Access, along with CRM and insurance administration systems such as Salesforce. . Follow up with producers and assistants regarding Renewal/Add Issue status; engage Sales Consultants as needed to help close the sale. Review Experience Reports with Sales Consultants for the Select Market segment; Package/deliver appropriate reports based on Sales Consultant’s authorization; Understand, interpret, and clearly communicate renewal rates, options, and add issue quotes to the Producer/Assistant. Deliver renewals to the Producer/Assistant/Planholder via email or mail for the Select Market segment. Serve as Subject Matter Expert on various Guardian systems (Salesforce, CPS, Panorama, etc.) capabilities, products, and workflow procedures. Job Description: Guardian is seeking a Group Benefits Regional Sales Leader in the Chicago market who will be responsible for driving and executing a profitable growth strategy through ongoing sales and retention with brokers. The role will cover groups of 2-2,000 lives with a primary focus down market. The Regional Sales Leader will do this by leading, coaching, and developing a high-performing team. The role will work closely with leadership and internal partners to leverage data when delivering on Guardian’s promise to inspire well-being, managing top and bottom-line growth strategies, and identifying opportunities to increase broker value. Success of this role will be largely dependent on the achievement of financial results, internal and external relationships, and the ability to recruit high potential, early-career talent. You will: Develop a sales plan to achieve corporate, financial, and market goals to maximize profitability, growth, retention, and increased market share. Be a champion of bringing in new talent and developing their skills and capabilities in order for colleagues to grow their careers at Guardian. Take a hands-on approach, particularly with larger accounts, coach reps in consultative selling, partnership with Underwriting, finalist presentations, and closing opportunities on new business. Work collaboratively and create followership with internal cross-functional partners (Underwriting, Client Management, Product, Finance, etc.) to achieve corporate, financial, and market objectives. Identify, recommend, and champion process improvement and organizational initiatives to positively influence outcomes. Cultivate strong external relationships with top brokers and distribution partners. Support the general well-being of the broker and client relationships for the development and growth of Guardian sales and client retention. You Have: 8+ years of group benefits industry experience; and proven leadership experience within group benefits. An understanding of relevant functional areas including Distribution, Underwriting, Finance, Pricing, Product Development, Marketing, Operations, Risk Management, and Administration. Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred. Familiarity and/or experience with group benefits product line preferred. Required industry licensing within 90 days of date of hire and maintain license through completing Continuing Education requirements. Soft Skills: Exercise sound judgment and integrity in a changing, matrixed, and fast-paced environment. Drive discipline and hold people accountable to achieving results. Persuasive presentation and communications skills with ability to influence people over whom there is no direct authority. Enable and support a culture of inclusivity by treating all employees, customers, and vendors with dignity and respect. Exude confidence, positivity, and proactivity. Location and Travel Requirements: The successful hire will be based in Chicago, IL. The focus is on operational reliability, security-by-default patterns, and disciplined platform lifecycle management that accelerates developer productivity while reducing operational risk. A pragmatic "get-things-done" engineer who can move fluently between platform design, scripting, debugging, and incident response. Integrate approved security scanning tooling into delivery and platform pipelines for dependency and container image scanning. Mentor engineers and contribute to raising overall platform engineering, automation, and operational maturity. Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or equivalent tools. Experience building and operating CI/CD automation using Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions. Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Shell. Solid understanding of how application architecture decisions impact reliability, security, and operations. Experience designing and operating platforms consumed by multiple application teams at enterprise scale. The role will shape a modern, scalable wealth technology ecosystem that supports planning-led engagement, advisor productivity, digital onboarding, client servicing, and integrated reporting across the wealth management ecosystem. This is a transformational leadership role responsible for building the platform, operating model, and technology capabilities needed to deliver a digital-first advisor and client experience while supporting the growth of Park Avenue and Guardian Wealth Partners You Will Define and execute the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap for Park Avenue and Guardian Wealth Partners across planning, advisory, onboarding, servicing, advisor workflow, and reporting capabilities. Own the architecture and evolution of a modern, cloud-based wealth technology platform that integrates planning, portfolio management, digital onboarding, data, AI, APIs, and enterprise reporting. Lead roadmap governance, investment prioritization, and portfolio trade-off decisions to align technology delivery with business growth, advisor productivity, client experience, and regulatory priorities. Deliver core capabilities required for a scalable wealth management and in-house RIA platform, including holistic financial planning, digital onboarding, asset aggregation, portfolio tools, reporting, and servicing. Ensure the platform is designed and operated with strong regulatory, cybersecurity, data privacy, supervisory, resiliency, and control frameworks appropriate for wealth management, RIA, and broker-dealer environments. Enable an agile business-technology operating model that improves prioritization, accelerates delivery, strengthens accountability, and enables measurable business outcomes. Lead end-to-end technology delivery across architecture, engineering, data, integration, vendor management, implementation, and production readiness. Build, develop, and lead high-performing cross-functional teams across internal technology groups, business partners, and strategic vendors. Partner with senior business, product, risk, compliance, operations, and technology leaders to translate strategy into outcomes that improve advisor productivity, client acquisition, engagement, retention, and service quality. Track record building and leading high-performing teams across internal engineering organizations, external partners, and strategic vendors. Strong commercial and delivery discipline, with experience managing complex portfolios, budgets, vendor relationships, and measurable business outcomes. Technical fluency in modern digital architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integration patterns, data/AI enablement, cybersecurity, resiliency, and scalable platform design. Job Description: The Model Risk & Validation Lead position is a crucial role on the Model Risk Management team, which is a new and expanding unit at Guardian. As such, this person will have the opportunity to contribute to the strategy and execution of this developing team. The Model Risk Management team oversees a scope of products including but not limited to life, annuity, disability, group business, and funding agreements, with a focus on statutory and economic frameworks. Risks pertaining to the emerging and quickly evolving space of artificial intelligence will command specific attention, as well as those related to assumption governance and oversight. Effective collaboration and engagement amongst the internal team as well as with the various business areas is essential towards achieving success in this role. You will Perform validations of models across the company in an independent manner, which includes but is not limited to: Collecting models, documentation, and other relevant artifacts. Engaging in meetings with the modeling teams and other relevant stakeholders to understand the modeling processes and develop knowledge on product or technology details. Reviewing the end-to-end process of the model, which includes the input, calculation, and output components, as well as the governance procedures, controls, and other relevant aspects of the models and processes. Understanding the model methodologies and assumptions and challenge for weaknesses. Recording and organizing all findings and/or issues that may arise from the validation exercises. Verbally communicate validation results and discuss issues or challenges with targeted internal audiences and other stakeholders. Engage in the entire model lifecycle including supporting validation efforts during model development phases. Address any potential future misstatements or inaccuracies through facilitating optimal model and process design and implementation of preventative and detective controls. Contribute to the continued growth and development of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics risk management through independent governance and validation activities within the Model Risk Management framework. Support the Head of Model Risk Governance through independent assessment and challenge of model assumptions within the Model Risk Management framework, including reasonableness, limitations, interdependencies, governance controls, alignment with intended use, and experience tracking. Maintain and manage the model validation findings inventory, including issue severity assessment, remediation tracking, and validation closure support. Support independent data risk assessments on model-adjacent data assets, such as applications. Lead presentations related to model validation outcomes, emerging model risks, and thematic observations across the enterprise. Communicate with targeted internal audiences and other stakeholders to ensure alignment with the model risk management policy and foster a company culture that understands and adheres to model risk management best practices. You are A self-motivated person, able to work independently. A strategic thinker, with the ability to “connect the dots” across the organization, and develop creative solutions to dynamic, complex, and unique business challenges. A trusted partner who can build strong and effective relationships across a wide range of stakeholders and customers. Technically proficient regarding model and process infrastructure as well as being an effective communicator. Results-oriented and able to execute tasks efficiently. Comfortable setting direction within a growing model validation function. You have 5+ years of experience in the insurance or financial services industry, preferably with experience in actuarial science and/or risk management. Very strong technical skills with a variety of modeling platforms. Proven leadership and communication skills. The ability to accelerate impact and the desire to lead change. Strong understanding of risk assessment frameworks (e.g., RCSA, KRI monitoring, risk scoring methodologies). Job Description: This role sits at the intersection of hands-on incident response, cyber defense and threat mitigation. You will be part of a highly collaborative cyber defense and incident response organization, responding to and investigating high-impact security incidents. The ideal candidate is an analytical, curious, and resilient technical leader with a strong investigative mindset and a desire to reduce risk through decisive action. You bring deep knowledge of modern attack techniques and frameworks, communicate clearly under pressure, and naturally step in to respond to and lead incidents during critical situations. You thrive in partnership working closely with security, IT, legal, HR, communications, and business teams to drive effective identification, containment, investigation, response, and recovery. You Have 5-7 years of overall cybersecurity experience, with a focus in digital forensics, incident response, SOC, or threat mitigation. Broad and deep technical expertise across enterprise environments, including public cloud and SaaS platforms. Experience with AI models, LLM's and implementing AI for Cyber detection response. Eagerness to grow within the security leadership and obtain experience, ideally in incident response or cyber defense, with a player/coach mindset. Strong command of incident response methodologies, digital forensics principles, and evidence handling. Knowledge and experience in threat hunting, malware analysis, attacker techniques, and common vulnerabilities. Practical experience working with NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, and related security frameworks. Hands-on experience with SIEM and log analytics platforms including logging, monitoring, insider threat, and UBA concepts. Ability to translate cyber threat intelligence into actionable detections, mitigations, and response strategies. Experience operating in regulated environments, preferably financial services or insurance, with understanding of U.S. privacy regulations. Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing technical teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience engaging technical teams, executives, and cross‑functional partners. Analytical, curious, and resilient under pressure; able to think structurally and creatively during incidents. BS or MS in cyber security, digital forensics, or equivalent experience and/or industry certifications preferred. A continuous, lifelong learner with a desire to grow into broader cyber leadership. You Will: Investigate complex, high-impact cyber incidents advanced from the SOC. Act as a technical lead, working as part of a collaborative team responding to actions across cybersecurity security teams while collaborating with legal, enterprise technology, engineering, and other internal teams. Contribute to and refine test incident response plans, playbooks, quick-reference guides, and crisis communication procedures. Partner with first-line SOC teams to build muscle memory, clarify containment authorities, and standardize response actions. Coordinate with business continuity/disaster recovery teams to ensure an integrated response to large-scale cyber events. Drive continuous improvement of logging, monitoring, detection coverage, and UBA capabilities, proactively identifying gaps. Ensure incidents are tracked, reported, and reviewed, with high-quality after-action reports and meaningful metrics. Collaborate across teams through cross-functional incident response training events, and debriefs to align on threats, trends, and lessons learned. Lead risk mitigation initiatives and improvements to security control effectiveness. Collaborate with cybersecurity leadership on strategy, roadmap development, vendor management, and talent planning. Contribute to enterprise programs such as DLP and insider risk management. Support internal and external audits, regulatory requests, and due diligence activities. Continuously identify opportunities to enhance incident response maturity, automation, and cyber defense capabilities. Drive our user behavior analytics (UBA) program working with the business to develop and improve appropriate logging monitoring. Develop standard operating procedures for our 1st line SOC based on threats/observed incidents. Job Title: Group Benefits Sales Executive, Advisory Market - Northern California
Job Description: Do you want to be a part of a high performing Group Benefits Sales team? Do you have a passion for building strong and lasting relationships with customers? Do you take pride in your consultative selling skills? Are you a team player who excels at collaborating across internal teams? Guardian is seeking a Group Benefits Sales Executive who will be responsible for building and maintaining relationships with our largest brokers and consulting houses to drive ongoing sales and retention of groups primarily in the large market segment. Success will be determined based on the ability to attain high levels of production through tenacious broker development and internal relationships. A Guardian Sales Executive should be the resource of choice for brokers and their clients This role will report to the Market Leader within the assigned territory. You will: Market, position, and sell Guardian’s Group Benefits products and technology solutions to large market brokers and consulting houses. This includes Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Absence, and Supplemental Health products. Support the general wellbeing of the broker and client relationship for the development and growth of Guardian sales and client retention. Understand local territory dynamics to build, develop and maintain broker relationships to grow the book of business while representing Guardian’s vision to inspire well-being. Be accountable for consistently achieving or exceeding personal sales production by creating growth with large regional and national broker consultants and implementing sales strategies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to examine market trends and stay ahead of consumer demands. Represent Guardian by acting as a market leader, sharing thought leadership and maintaining strong community relationships. Identify, recommend and champion process improvements and organizational initiatives to increase sales of product offerings. Achieve required industry licensing within 90 days of date of hire and maintain license through completing Continuing Education requirements. You Have: A BS, BA degree or equivalent industry experience A minimum of 10 years’ previous group insurance sales experience or a combination of Guardian work experience, education and/or related extracurricular activities Experience working with large, complex national accounts along with large Regional and national broker consultants Experience and knowledge of relevant industry products and processes including, but not limited to Worksite, LTD, Dental products, complex absence products, experience rating, dental network analysis processes Soft Skills: Collaborative team player with the ability to effectively build rapport in person and virtually. Exercise sound judgement and integrity in a changing, matrixed, and fast past environment. Exude confidence, positivity, and proactivity. Act with accountability to deliver on commitments with speed and quality. Team player with ability to build relationships and effectively interact both internally and externally with people at all levels of the organization and customer orientation.
